Delinquent.name: Delinquent
Delinquent.description:
😤 You skipped classes and hung out in back streets.

🏫 You left a reputation the teachers still mention.
🧭 You know the back streets and how to stare someone down.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +5, Intimidation +5
Delinquent.traitNarrativeEffects: The character spent high school on the wrong side of the rules: fights behind the station, truancy, older friends with bad habits. They know the streets and how to look dangerous; teachers and police remember them.
